title: 5.14 At the Table
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Name seven things at the table and say what a cup, a glass, a bottle or a plate holds.
grammar_function: It is a + thing; It is salt/sugar; a + container + of + drink or food.
prerequisite: 2.4 It is a + noun; 5.2 rice; 5.3 water, milk, tea.
speaking_outcome: Say It is a glass., A glass of water and A cup of tea.
